integrity: Complete proof reduces all first-coordinate fibers to even quartics and applies character-square pair counting. Explicit finite-field checks are corroborative. First public date is the day-dated public appearance of the earliest source used; no finding publication date is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Twofold sums of even quartic graphs only; no higher sums, generic quartic deformations, or sharp weighted extension norm.
Some underlying one-variable quartic image counts and the zero-coefficient additive energy are previously established; they are not presented as new.
An exact equivalent in unindexed specialized literature may remain undetected.

title: Complete twofold-sum multiplicity spectrum for even-quartic graphs over finite fields
